# Alibaba.com

> Alibaba.com is the world's largest online B2B marketplace connecting manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, and importers for global trade and sourcing.

Alibaba.com serves as a comprehensive B2B platform enabling international commerce across major markets including China, the United States, Mexico, Europe, Türkiye, and Southeast Asia. The platform provides tools for supplier discovery, quotation requests, buyer protection, and trade show participation.

## Key Topics

- B2B Marketplace
- Manufacturers & Suppliers
- Global Trade
- Import-Export
- Request for Quotation (RFQ)
- Sourcing Platform
- Alibaba Factory
- Buyer Central
- International Commerce
- Buyer Protection
- Trade Show
- China
- United States
- Southeast Asia

## Core Marketplace

- [Alibaba.com: Manufacturers, Suppliers, Exporters & Importers](https://www.alibaba.com/factory/index.html): Main B2B marketplace connecting manufacturers, suppliers, and importers globally with comprehensive sourcing and trading capabilities
- [Global B2B Trade Platform](https://www.alibaba.com/global/index.html): International commerce platform serving major markets across US, Mexico, Europe, Türkiye, and Asia for cross-border buying and selling
